title: cynoglossum glabratum
intro: Cynoglossum glabratum, commonly known as the hairy tongue flower, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae) native to tropical Africa. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Cynoglossum glabratum are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve coughs, and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
